prompt: Some people think that the increase in the number of obese people should be the responsibility of the governments, while other think it should be the responsibility of individuals. Discuss both sides and give your opinion
essay:
The number of obese people is rapidly increasing every year. While some believe that authorities should be held accountable for the rise in obesity rates, others argue that every person is to blame for this phenomenon. In this essay, I will analyze both arguments and will provide my opinion on the matter.

On the one hand, governments somewhat affect the rising obesity rate by allowing unhealthy food companies to advertise their products on television and social media platforms. To make a strong impression on the audience, these companies frequently hire renowned personalities from the sports industry or Hollywood to promote their products. Consequently, these strategies motivate consumers who admire their idols to purchase goods despite their harmful effects on well-being. Ultimately, these dietary practices may result in excess weight.

On the other hand, individuals are also accountable for consuming healthy meals to stay in shape. However, many people prefer dining out because preparing food at home can be time-consuming. To give an example, the entire cooking process, including meal planning, grocery shopping, chopping ingredients, cooking, setting the table, eating, and cleaning up, can take at least two hours. Furthermore, meals in most restaurants often have larger portions with high calories, which could result in weight gain if consumed regularly. Hence, eating out should not be the preference, but the last resort. 

In conclusion, for the increase in the overweight population, although state officials have some responsibility for permitting the promotion of unhealthy foods, I believe individuals are more at fault for choosing an easy way out by eating outside instead of cooking at home. Therefore, they need to step up and take some positive steps to overcome this predicament.
